title: Kissed Charred Mediterranean Bean Tagine
description: A charred, fluffy, and savory Mediterranean dish featuring chilli bean paste and dashi extract, perfect for midnight cravings. This vegetarian-friendly tagine is a hearty and flavorful option for any time of day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chilli bean paste, dashi extract, olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the paste mixture.
Add the canned chickpeas to the bowl and stir until they are fully incorporated into the paste mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a large cast-iron skillet or tagine dish.
Bake the mixture in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is lightly charred and fluffy.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped fresh parsley over the top.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
